164        public SDResolution(TextPanelAPI text, boolean withIntelNotification) {
165                super();
166                
167                Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(KEY, this);
168

170

172                Global.getSector().getIntelManager().addIntel(this, !withIntelNotification, text);
173        }
174        
175        protected Object readResolve() {
176                boolean recreate = true;
177                for (EventStageData curr : stages) {
178                        if (curr.id == Stage.ACHILLES_ATTACK) {
179                                recreate = false;
180                                break;
181                        }
182                }
183                
184                if (recreate) {
185                        setup();
186                }
187                
188                return this;
189        }

192        protected void setup() {
193                factors.clear();
194                stages.clear();
195                
196                setMaxProgress(ACHILLES);
197                
198                addStage(Stage.HECTOR, HECTOR, StageIconSize.LARGE);
199                addStage(Stage.ACHILLES_ATTACK, ACHILLES_ATTACK, StageIconSize.MEDIUM);
200                addStage(Stage.HECTOR_ATTACK, HECTOR_ATTACK, StageIconSize.MEDIUM);
201                addStage(Stage.ACHILLES, ACHILLES, StageIconSize.LARGE);
202                
203                getDataFor(Stage.HECTOR).showIconIfFirstStage = true;
204                
205                getDataFor(Stage.HECTOR).keepIconBrightWhenLaterStageReached = true;
206                getDataFor(Stage.HECTOR).alwaysShowIconAtFullBrightness = true;
207                getDataFor(Stage.HECTOR).sendIntelUpdateOnReaching = false;
208                
209                getDataFor(Stage.ACHILLES).keepIconBrightWhenLaterStageReached = true;
210                getDataFor(Stage.ACHILLES).alwaysShowIconAtFullBrightness = true;
211                getDataFor(Stage.ACHILLES).sendIntelUpdateOnReaching = false;
212                
213                getDataFor(Stage.ACHILLES_ATTACK).keepIconBrightWhenLaterStageReached = true;
214                getDataFor(Stage.ACHILLES_ATTACK).alwaysShowIconAtFullBrightness = true;
215                getDataFor(Stage.ACHILLES_ATTACK).sendIntelUpdateOnReaching = false;
216                
217                getDataFor(Stage.HECTOR_ATTACK).keepIconBrightWhenLaterStageReached = true;
218                getDataFor(Stage.HECTOR_ATTACK).alwaysShowIconAtFullBrightness = true;
219                getDataFor(Stage.HECTOR_ATTACK).sendIntelUpdateOnReaching = false;
220                
221                addFactor(new SDRMacarioFactor());
222                
223                setProgress(maxProgress / 2);
224                
225                hectorWinReached = false;
226                achillesWinReached = false;
227        }

253        protected void addBulletPoints(TooltipMakerAPI info, ListInfoMode mode, boolean isUpdate, 
254                                                                        Color tc, float initPad) {
255                
256                if (addEventFactorBulletPoints(info, mode, isUpdate, tc, initPad)) {
257                        return;
258                }
259                
260                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
261                if (isUpdate && getListInfoParam() instanceof EventStageData) {
262                        EventStageData esd = (EventStageData) getListInfoParam();
263                        
264                        if (esd.id == Stage.HECTOR) {
265                                info.addPara("Hector Andrada declares victory", tc, initPad);
266                        } else if (esd.id == Stage.ACHILLES) {
267                                info.addPara("Achilles Andrada declares victory", tc, initPad);
268                        } else if (esd.id == Stage.ACHILLES_ATTACK) {
269                                info.addPara("The forces of Achilles launch a last-ditch attack", tc, initPad);
270                                // TODO hyder notification? maybe in tooltip?
271                        } else if (esd.id == Stage.HECTOR_ATTACK) {
272                                info.addPara("Hector's forces launch a last-ditch attack", tc, initPad);
273                        }
274                        
275                        return;
276                }
277        }

394        protected String getStageIconImpl(Object stageId) {
395                EventStageData esd = getDataFor(stageId);
396                if (esd == null) return null;
397                
398        
399                if (esd.id == Stage.HECTOR) {
400                        return getHector().getPortraitSprite();
401                }
402                if (esd.id == Stage.ACHILLES) {
403                        return getAchilles().getPortraitSprite();
404                }
405                if (esd.id == Stage.ACHILLES_ATTACK) {
406                        return Global.getSettings().getSpriteName("events", "sd_resolution_imminent_attack_achilles");
407                }
408                if (esd.id == Stage.HECTOR_ATTACK) {
409                        return Global.getSettings().getSpriteName("events", "sd_resolution_imminent_attack_hector");
410                }
411                // should not happen
412                return Global.getSettings().getSpriteName("events", "sd_resolution");
413        }

470        @Override
471        public void setProgress(int progress) {
472                if (progress <= HECTOR) {
473                        hectorWinReached = true;
474                }
475                if (progress >= ACHILLES) {
476                        achillesWinReached = true;
477                }
478                super.setProgress(progress);
479        }

481        @Override
482        protected void advanceImpl(float amount) {
483                super.advanceImpl(amount);
484                
485                //Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$askoniaStandoff", true);
486                
487                // just to make it work for existing saves
488                if (!triedAddingFuelShortage) {
489                        if (SDFuelShortage.get() == null) {
490                                new SDFuelShortage();
491                        }
492                        triedAddingFuelShortage = true;
493                }
494                
495                float days = Global.getSector().getClock().convertToDays(amount);
496                
497                personalFleetDefeats.advance(days);
498                
499                //if (amount > 0) progress++;
500//              setProgress(180);
501//              setProgress(20);
502//              setProgress(200);
503//              setProgress(0);
504                
505                
506//              EventStageData hector = getDataFor(Stage.HECTOR);
507//              EventStageData achilles = getDataFor(Stage.ACHILLES);
508//              if (hector != null && achilles != null && (hector.wasEverReached || achilles.wasEverReached)) {
509                //if (progress <= HECTOR || progress >= ACHILLES) {
510                if (hectorWinReached || achillesWinReached) {
511                        endImmediately();
512                        //StandoffWinner winner = progress <= HECTOR ? StandoffWinner.HECTOR : StandoffWinner.ACHILLES;
513                        //StandoffWinner winner = hector.wasEverReached ? StandoffWinner.HECTOR : StandoffWinner.ACHILLES;
514                        StandoffWinner winner = !achillesWinReached ? StandoffWinner.HECTOR : StandoffWinner.ACHILLES;
515                        endStandoffInAskonia(winner);
516                        if (winner == StandoffWinner.HECTOR) {
517                                sendUpdateIfPlayerHasIntel(getDataFor(Stage.HECTOR), getTextPanelForStageChange());
518                                Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$sdse_hectorWon", true);
519                        } else {
520                                sendUpdateIfPlayerHasIntel(getDataFor(Stage.ACHILLES), getTextPanelForStageChange());
521                                Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$sdse_achillesWon", true);
522                        }
523                        return;
524                }
525                
526                //doLastDitchAttackAchilles();
527                if (!didLastDitchAttack && achillesArrived) {
528                        if (progress <= ACHILLES_ATTACK) {
529                                doLastDitchAttackAchilles();
530                                sendUpdateIfPlayerHasIntel(getDataFor(Stage.ACHILLES_ATTACK), getTextPanelForStageChange());
531                                didLastDitchAttack = true;
532                                return;
533                        } else if (progress >= HECTOR_ATTACK) {
534                                doLastDitchAttackHector();
535                                sendUpdateIfPlayerHasIntel(getDataFor(Stage.HECTOR_ATTACK), getTextPanelForStageChange());
536                                didLastDitchAttack = true;
537                                return;
538                        }
539                }
540        }

568        public static boolean canBeginStandoffInAskonia() {
569                for (String mid : INVOLVED_MARKETS) { 
570                        MarketAPI market = Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket(mid);
571                        if (market == null || market.hasCondition(Conditions.DECIVILIZED)) {
572                                return false;
573                        }
574                }
575                return true;
576        }
577        
578        public static boolean beginStandoffInAskonia(TextPanelAPI textPanel, boolean withIntel) {
579                if (!canBeginStandoffInAskonia()) {
580                        return false;
581                }
582                
583                Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$askoniaStandoff", true);
584                
585                new SDDevastation(textPanel, false);
586                new SDResolution(textPanel, true);
587                
588                new SDFuelShortage();
589                
590                
591                for (String mid : INVOLVED_MARKETS) { 
592                        Misc.makeStoryCritical(mid, STORY_CRITICAL_ID);
593                }
594                
595                CampaignFleetAPI hyder = strengthenAndGetPersonalFleet(PersonalFleetOxanaHyder.class, true);
596                CampaignFleetAPI caden = strengthenAndGetPersonalFleet(PersonalFleetHoracioCaden.class, true);
597                MarketAPI volturn = Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket("volturn");
598                MarketAPI sindria = Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket("sindria");
599                StarSystemAPI askonia = sindria.getStarSystem();
600                if (hyder == null || caden == null || sindria == null || volturn == null ||  
601                                askonia == null) return false;
602                
603                sindria.getStats().getDynamic().getStat(Stats.COMBAT_FLEET_SPAWN_RATE_MULT).modifyMult(MODIFIER_ID, 0f);
604                askonia.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.SYSTEM_SUSPEND_MILITARY_RESPONSE_SCRIPT, true);
605                
606                for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
607                        PatrolType type = PatrolType.HEAVY;
608                        if (i >= 3) {
609                                type = PatrolType.COMBAT;
610                        }
611                        CampaignFleetAPI fleet = MilitaryBase.createPatrol(type, 0f, Factions.DIKTAT, null, null, askonia.getLocation(), null);
612                        fleet.setLocation(sindria.getPrimaryEntity().getLocation().x, sindria.getPrimaryEntity().getLocation().y);
613                        askonia.addEntity(fleet);
614                }
615                
616                for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
617                        PatrolType type = PatrolType.HEAVY;
618                        if (i >= 3) {
619                                type = PatrolType.COMBAT;
620                        }
621                        CampaignFleetAPI fleet = MilitaryBase.createPatrol(type, 0f, Factions.LIONS_GUARD, null, null, askonia.getLocation(), null);
622                        fleet.setLocation(sindria.getPrimaryEntity().getLocation().x, sindria.getPrimaryEntity().getLocation().y);
623                        fleet.setFaction(Factions.DIKTAT);
624                        for (FleetMemberAPI member : fleet.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy()) {
625                                if (member.isCapital()) {
626                                        member.setVariant(member.getVariant().clone(), false, false);
627                                        member.getVariant().setSource(VariantSource.REFIT);
628                                        member.getVariant().addTag(Tags.TAG_NO_AUTOFIT);
629                                        member.getVariant().addTag(Tags.VARIANT_CONSISTENT_WEAPON_DROPS);
630                                }
631                        }
632                        
633                        askonia.addEntity(fleet);
634                }
635                
636                for (CampaignFleetAPI curr : askonia.getFleets()) {
637                        if (!curr.getFaction().getId().equals(Factions.DIKTAT)) continue;
638                        if (Misc.isPatrol(curr) || Misc.isWarFleet(curr)) {
639                                curr.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_PATROL_ALLOW_TOFF, true);
640                                curr.removeScriptsOfClass(PatrolAssignmentAIV4.class);
641                                curr.removeScriptsOfClass(TriggerFleetAssignmentAI.class);
642                                curr.clearAssignments();
643                                curr.addScript(new LeashAssignmentAI(curr, askonia, sindria.getPrimaryEntity(), null));
644                        }
645                }
646                
647                FactionAPI diktat = Global.getSector().getFaction(Factions.DIKTAT);
648                FactionHostilityManager.getInstance().setExcluded(Factions.DIKTAT, true);
649                for (FactionHostilityIntel intel : FactionHostilityManager.getInstance().getHostilitiesInvolving(diktat)) {
650                        if (intel.isEnded() || intel.isEnding()) continue;
651                        intel.endHostilties();
652                }
653                
654                FactionAPI reformers = Global.getSector().getFaction(Factions.DIKTAT_ACHILLES);
655                reformers.setShowInIntelTab(true);
656                
657                diktat.setRelationship(Factions.TRITACHYON, 0.25f);
658                diktat.setRelationship(Factions.PERSEAN, -0.25f);
659                
660                reformers.setRelationship(Factions.TRITACHYON, -0.25f);
661                reformers.setRelationship(Factions.PERSEAN, 0.25f);
662                reformers.setRelationship(Factions.PIRATES, -0.50f);
663                reformers.setRelationship(Factions.LUDDIC_PATH, -0.50f);
664                
665                // This is a pretty crude way to do it, but what the heck.
666                if (Global.getSector().getPlayerMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdse_proAchilles")) {
667                        if (Global.getSector().getPlayerMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdse_acceptedAchillesCeremonyInvite")) {
668                                reformers.setRelationship(Factions.PLAYER, 0.35f);
669                        }
670                        else {
671                                reformers.setRelationship(Factions.PLAYER, 0.25f);
672                        }
673                }
674                // Likewise crude.
675                if (Global.getSector().getPlayerMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdse_proHector")) {
676                        reformers.setRelationship(Factions.PLAYER, -0.50f);
677                }
678                
679                
680                AchillesForces.createHectorFleet();
681                
682                sendAchillesForces();
683                
684                if (    Global.getSector().getPlayerMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sd7s_maeusWillFightDolosRogue")) {
685                        spawnMorozFleet(true);
686                }
687                else if (       Global.getSector().getPlayerMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sd7s_maeusWillHelpFight")) {
688                        spawnMorozFleet(false);
689                }
690                
691                return true;
692        }

733        public static void triggerHyderChangesSides() {
734                MarketAPI volturn = Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket("volturn");
735                MarketAPI nortia = Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket("nortia");
736                MarketAPI sindria = Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket("sindria");
737                StarSystemAPI askonia = volturn.getStarSystem();
738
739                // lower defection rate if Hyder doesn't put her support behind Achilles.
740                float switchSidesChance = 0.3f;
741                if(Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdr_hyderDecidedToBackAchilles")) {
742                        switchSidesChance = 0.5f;
743                }
744                
745                Set<CampaignFleetAPI> changingSides = new LinkedHashSet<>();
746                CampaignFleetAPI hyder = strengthenAndGetPersonalFleet(PersonalFleetOxanaHyder.class, false);
747                
748                if( !Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdr_hyderDecidedToBackHector")) {
749                        changingSides.add(hyder);
750                }
751                
752                for (CampaignFleetAPI fleet : askonia.getFleets()) {
753                        if (!fleet.getFaction().getId().equals(Factions.DIKTAT)) continue;
754                        boolean lg = fleet.getName().toLowerCase().contains("lion's guard");
755                        if (fleet != hyder && Misc.isPatrol(fleet) && !lg && (float) Math.random() < switchSidesChance) {
756                                changingSides.add(fleet);
757                        }
758                        
759                        // we need at least one traitor
760                        if(changingSides.size() == 0 && fleet != hyder && Misc.isPatrol(fleet) && !lg) {
761                                changingSides.add(fleet);
762                        }
763                }
764                                
765                for (CampaignFleetAPI fleet : changingSides) {
766                        fleet.clearAssignments();
767                        fleet.removeScriptsOfClass(LeashAssignmentAI.class);
768                        fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$sdrChangingSides", true);
769                        fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.FLEET_BUSY, true);
770                        fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.FLEET_IGNORES_OTHER_FLEETS, true);
771                        fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.FLEET_IGNORED_BY_OTHER_FLEETS, true);
772                        fleet.addAssignment(FleetAssignment.GO_TO_LOCATION, nortia.getPrimaryEntity(), 10000f, "conducting training exercise", new Script() {
773                                @Override
774                                public void run() {
775                                        
776                                        if (isAskoniaStandoffCompleted()) {
777                                                // We might be hitting this if we get too enthusiastic during testing, but just to be sure...
778                                                return;
779                                        }
780                                        
781                                        if (fleet.getFaction().getId().equals(Factions.DIKTAT)) {
782                                                
783                                                // announce arrest here, if it's happening.
784                                                if(     Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdr_macarioArrestHyder") && 
785                                                        !Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdr_hyderArrestDone")) {
786                                                        
787                                                        Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$sdr_hyderArrestDone", true);
788                                                        
789                                                        // Hyder arrested intel
790                                                        MessageIntel intel = new MessageIntel();
791                                                        PersonAPI person = Global.getSector().getImportantPeople().getPerson(People.HYDER);
792                                                        if(person != null) {
793                                                                
794                                                                intel.addLine( person.getNameString() + " has been arrested and stripped of command at the order of Chief High Inspector-General Dolos Macario", null, 
795                                                                                         new String[] {person.getNameString()}, 
796                                                                                                                   person.getFaction().getColor()); 
797                                                                
798                                                                intel.setIcon(person.getPortraitSprite());
799                                                        }
800                                                        
801                                                        SDResolution sdr = SDResolution.get();
802                                                        sdr.addOrReplaceFactor(new SDRHyderFactor(), null);             
803                                                        removeFleetCommander(hyder);
804                                                        Global.getSector().getCampaignUI().addMessage(intel);
805                                                }
806                                                
807                                                // announce her defection here, if it's happening.
808                                                if ( Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdr_hyderDecidedToBackAchilles") && 
809                                                         !Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdr_macarioArrestHyder") && 
810                                                         !Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdr_hyderToAchillesDone")) {
811                                                        
812                                                        Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$sdr_hyderToAchillesDone", true);
813                                                        
814                                                        // Hyder defection intel alert!
815                                                        MessageIntel intel = new MessageIntel();
816                                                        PersonAPI person = Global.getSector().getImportantPeople().getPerson(People.HYDER);
817                                                        if(person != null) {
818                                                                
819                                                                String _intelText = person.getNameString() + " has pledged the " + hyder.getName() + " to the cause of Achilles Andrada";
820                                                                
821                                                                // failed arrest due to player meddling
822                                                                if(Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdse_macarioArrestHyderFail")) {
823                                                                        _intelText = person.getNameString() + " thwarted an arrest attempt by INTSEC then pledged the " + hyder.getName() + " to the cause of Achilles Andrada";
824                                                                }
825
826                                                                intel.addLine(  _intelText,
827                                                                                                null, 
828                                                                                                new String[] {person.getNameString()}, 
829                                                                                                person.getFaction().getColor()); 
830                                                                
831                                                                
832                                                                intel.setIcon(person.getPortraitSprite());
833                                                        }
834                                                        
835                                                        SDResolution sdr = SDResolution.get();
836                                                        sdr.addOrReplaceFactor(new SDRHyderFactor(), null);             
837                                                        
838                                                        //intel.setIcon(Global.getSettings().getSpriteName("intel_categories", "reputation"));
839                                                        Global.getSector().getCampaignUI().addMessage(intel);
840                                                }
841                                                
842                                                // when the first fleet gets there, kick off the change of allegiance for all of them
843                                                for (CampaignFleetAPI fleet2 : changingSides) {
844                                                        
845                                                        fleet2.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().unset("$sdrChangingSides");
846                                                        fleet2.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().unset(MemFlags.FLEET_IGNORES_OTHER_FLEETS);
847                                                        fleet2.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().unset(MemFlags.FLEET_IGNORED_BY_OTHER_FLEETS);
848                                                        
849                                                        // if Hyder gets arrested, her fleet returns to Sindria w/o changing sides.
850                                                        if(     fleet2 == hyder && 
851                                                                Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdr_hyderDecidedToBackAchiiles") && 
852                                                                !Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdr_macarioArrestHyder")) {
853                                                                
854                                                                fleet2.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().unset(MemFlags.FLEET_BUSY);
855                                                                // removeFleetCommander(fleet2); // done in the arrest announcement for ALL cases
856                                                                fleet2.addScript(new LeashAssignmentAI(fleet2, askonia, sindria.getPrimaryEntity(), null));
857                                                                continue;
858                                                        }
859
860                                                        fleet2.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().unset("$sdrChangingSides");
861                                                        fleet2.clearAssignments();
862                                                        fleet2.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_PATROL_ALLOW_TOFF, true);
863                                                        fleet2.setFaction(Factions.DIKTAT_ACHILLES);
864                                                        fleet2.addScript(new LeashAssignmentAI(fleet2, askonia, volturn.getPrimaryEntity(), "declaring for Achilles"));
865                                                }
866                                        }
867                                }
868                        });
869                }
870        }

924        public static void endStandoffInAskonia(StandoffWinner winner) {
925                log.info("SDResolution starting endStandoffInAskonia");
926                FactionAPI reformers = Global.getSector().getFaction(Factions.DIKTAT_ACHILLES);
927                reformers.setShowInIntelTab(false);
928                
929                SDFuelShortage.end();
930                
931                if (winner == StandoffWinner.ACHILLES) {
932                        FactionAPI diktat = Global.getSector().getFaction(Factions.DIKTAT);
933                        diktat.setRelationship(Factions.TRITACHYON, reformers.getRelationship(Factions.TRITACHYON));
934                        diktat.setRelationship(Factions.PERSEAN, reformers.getRelationship(Factions.PERSEAN));
935                        diktat.setRelationship(Factions.PLAYER, reformers.getRelationship(Factions.PLAYER));
936                        diktat.setRelationship(Factions.INDEPENDENT, reformers.getRelationship(Factions.INDEPENDENT));
937                }
938                
939                
940                for (String mid : INVOLVED_MARKETS) { 
941                        Misc.makeNonStoryCritical(mid, STORY_CRITICAL_ID);
942                }
943                
944                Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().unset("$askoniaStandoff");
945                Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$askoniaStandoffCompleted", true);
946                
947                MarketAPI sindria = Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket("sindria");
948                MarketAPI volturn = Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket("volturn");
949                MarketAPI cruor = Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket("cruor");
950                MarketAPI nortia = Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket("nortia");
951                MarketAPI umbra = Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket("umbra");
952                MarketAPI yesod = Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket("yesod");
953                
954                StarSystemAPI askonia = sindria.getStarSystem();
955                StarSystemAPI zagan = yesod == null ? null : yesod.getStarSystem();
956                sindria.getStats().getDynamic().getStat(Stats.COMBAT_FLEET_SPAWN_RATE_MULT).unmodifyMult(MODIFIER_ID);
957                askonia.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().unset(MemFlags.SYSTEM_SUSPEND_MILITARY_RESPONSE_SCRIPT);
958                
959                if (askonia != null) {
960                        List<CampaignFleetAPI> fleets = new ArrayList<>();
961                        fleets.addAll(askonia.getFleets());
962                        fleets.addAll(Global.getSector().getHyperspace().getFleets());
963                        if (zagan != null) {
964                                fleets.addAll(zagan.getFleets());
965                        }
966                        boolean sindriaBlowsUp = Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$cadenBlowsUpSindria");
967                        for (CampaignFleetAPI curr : fleets) {
968                                if (curr.getFaction().getId().equals(Factions.DIKTAT_ACHILLES)) {
969                                        curr.setFaction(Factions.DIKTAT);
970                                        MarketAPI source = Misc.getSourceMarket(curr);
971                                        if (source != null && source.getFactionId().equals(Factions.PERSEAN)) {
972                                                if (sindriaBlowsUp || winner == StandoffWinner.HECTOR || (float) Math.random() > 0.5f) {
973                                                        curr.setFaction(Factions.PERSEAN);
974                                                        Misc.giveStandardReturnToSourceAssignments(curr, true);
975                                                        curr.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(REFORMER_FLEET_RETURNING_TO_PL, true);
976                                                } else {
977                                                        curr.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_SOURCE_MARKET, "sindria");
978                                                        Misc.giveStandardReturnToSourceAssignments(curr, true);
979                                                }
980                                        }
981                                }
982                                if (!curr.getFaction().getId().equals(Factions.DIKTAT)) continue;
983                                if (Misc.isPatrol(curr) || Misc.isWarFleet(curr)) {
984                                        Misc.giveStandardReturnToSourceAssignments(curr, true);
985                                }
986                        }
987                        
988                        // some of these are handled specifically further down, but this is good baseline. -dgb.
989                        for (SectorEntityToken obj : askonia.getEntitiesWithTag(Tags.OBJECTIVE)) {
990                                if (obj.getFaction().getId().equals(Factions.DIKTAT_ACHILLES)) {
991                                        obj.setFaction(Factions.DIKTAT);
992                                        break;
993                                }
994                        }
995                }
996                
997                CampaignFleetAPI moroz = getMorozFleet();
998                if (moroz != null) {
999                        moroz.clearAssignments();
1000                        Misc.giveStandardReturnToSourceAssignments(moroz);
1001                        if (winner == StandoffWinner.ACHILLES) {
1002                                Misc.makeHostileToFaction(moroz, Factions.DIKTAT, false, -1f);
1003                        }
1004                }
1005                
1006                removeFleetCommander(PersonalFleetScript.getFleet(PersonalFleetOxanaHyder.class));
1007                removeFleetCommander(PersonalFleetScript.getFleet(PersonalFleetHoracioCaden.class));
1008                
1009                List<CampaignFleetAPI> fleets = new ArrayList<>();
1010                fleets.addAll(askonia.getFleets());
1011                fleets.addAll(Global.getSector().getHyperspace().getFleets());
1012                if (zagan != null) {
1013                        fleets.addAll(zagan.getFleets());
1014                }
1015                
1016                for (CampaignFleetAPI fleet : fleets) {
1017                        fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().unset(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_MAKE_HOSTILE_WHILE_TOFF);
1018                        if (fleet.getCommander() != null && fleet.getCommander().getId().equals(People.ACHILLES)) {
1019                                removeFleetCommander(fleet);
1020                                fleet.setNoFactionInName(false);
1021                                fleet.setName(fleet.getFaction().getFleetTypeName(FleetTypes.PATROL_LARGE));
1022                        } 
1023                        else if (fleet.getCommander() != null && fleet.getCommander().getId().equals(People.HECTOR)) {
1024                                removeFleetCommander(fleet);
1025                                fleet.setNoFactionInName(false);
1026                                fleet.setName(fleet.getFaction().getFleetTypeName(FleetTypes.PATROL_LARGE));
1027                        }
1028                }
1029                
1030                // stay non-hostile for a bit to let things settle down, let PL fleets leave, etc
1031                Global.getSector().addScript(new DelayedActionScript(30f) {
1032                        @Override
1033                        public void doAction() {
1034                                FactionHostilityManager.getInstance().setExcluded(Factions.DIKTAT, false);
1035                        }
1036                });
1037
1038                if (winner == StandoffWinner.ACHILLES) {
1039                        FactionAPI lionsGuard = Global.getSector().getFaction(Factions.LIONS_GUARD);
1040                        FactionAPI diktat = Global.getSector().getFaction(Factions.DIKTAT);

1934        // specific to SD, not generic
1935        public static void cleanUpFleetsAffectedByPlanetOrFactionDestruction() {
1936                
1937                boolean destroyed = Misc.getFactionMarkets(Factions.DIKTAT).isEmpty(); 
1938                if (destroyed) {
1939                        FactionAPI faction = Global.getSector().getFaction(Factions.DIKTAT);
1940                        faction.setShowInIntelTab(false);
1941                        
1942                        FactionCommissionIntel intel = Misc.getCommissionIntel();
1943                        if (intel != null && intel.getFaction() == faction) {
1944                                intel.sendUpdateIfPlayerHasIntel(FactionCommissionIntel.UPDATE_PARAM_ANNULLED, false, true);
1945                                Commission.resign(false, null);
1946                        }
1947                        
1948                        // Tell the player!
1949                        String _intelLine = "The Sindrian Diktat is no more.";
1950                        if(Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sindrianDiktatCollapsed")) {
1951                                _intelLine = "The Sindrian Diktat has collapsed.";
1952                        }
1953                        else if(Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdse_achillesWonPL") ) {
1954                                _intelLine = "The Sindrian Diktat is no longer an independent polity.";
1955                        }
1956                        
1957                        MessageIntel intel2 = new MessageIntel();
1958                        FactionAPI diktat = Global.getSector().getFaction(Factions.DIKTAT);

1961
1962                        intel2.setIcon(Global.getSettings().getSpriteName("events", "sd_devastation"));
1963                        Global.getSector().getCampaignUI().addMessage(intel2);
1964                }
1965                
1966                // this'll probably drop a frame or two
1967                for (LocationAPI curr : Global.getSector().getAllLocations()) {
1968                        for (CampaignFleetAPI fleet : curr.getFleets()) {
1969                                
1970//                              if ("dc05ae".equals(fleet.getId())) {
1971//                                      System.out.println("wefkwefwe");
1972//                              }
1973                                        
1974                                MemoryAPI mem = fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate();
1975                                if (mem.getBoolean(REFORMER_FLEET_RETURNING_TO_PL)) continue;
1976                                
1977                                boolean smuggler = mem.getBoolean(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_SMUGGLER);
1978                                boolean trader = mem.getBoolean(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_TRADE_FLEET);
1979                                
1980                                if (fleet.isPlayerFleet()) continue;
1981                                if (fleet.getFaction().isPlayerFaction() && !smuggler && !trader) continue;
1982                                
1983                                String sourceId = mem.getString(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_SOURCE_MARKET);
1984                                MarketAPI source = Misc.getSourceMarket(fleet);
1985                                
1986                                if (sourceId != null && source == null) {
1987                                        fleet.removeScriptsOfClass(PatrolAssignmentAIV4.class);
1988                                        Misc.setFlagWithReason(mem, MemFlags.FLEET_IGNORES_OTHER_FLEETS, "factionLost", true, -1f);
1989                                        // will return to some point in hyper and despawn
1990                                        Misc.giveStandardReturnToSourceAssignments(fleet);
1991                                        continue;
1992                                }
1993                                
1994                                RouteData route = RouteManager.getInstance().getRoute(EconomyFleetRouteManager.SOURCE_ID, fleet);
1995                                if (route != null) {
1996                                        EconomyRouteData data = (EconomyRouteData) route.getCustom();
1997                                        boolean fromExists = data.from != null && 
1998                                                                                 Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket(data.from.getId()) != null;
1999                                        boolean toExists = data.to != null && 
2000                                                                                 Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket(data.to.getId()) != null;
2001                                        if (!fromExists || !toExists) {
2002                                                fleet.removeScriptsOfClass(EconomyFleetAssignmentAI.class);
2003                                                fleet.removeScriptsOfClass(PatrolAssignmentAIV4.class);
2004                                                Misc.setFlagWithReason(mem, MemFlags.FLEET_IGNORES_OTHER_FLEETS, "factionLost", true, -1f);
2005                                                Misc.giveStandardReturnToSourceAssignments(fleet);
2006                                                RouteManager.getInstance().removeRoute(route);
2007                                                continue;
2008                                        }
2009                                }
2010                                
2011                                if (fleet.getFaction().getId().equals(Factions.DIKTAT)) {
2012                                        fleet.removeScriptsOfClass(PatrolAssignmentAIV4.class);
2013                                        fleet.removeScriptsOfClass(EconomyFleetAssignmentAI.class);
2014                                        Misc.setFlagWithReason(mem, MemFlags.FLEET_IGNORES_OTHER_FLEETS, "factionLost", true, -1f);
2015                                        Misc.giveStandardReturnToSourceAssignments(fleet);
2016                                        continue;
2017                                }
2018                                
2019                        }       
2020                }
2021                
2022                for (RouteData curr : new ArrayList<>(RouteManager.getInstance().getRoutes())) {
2023                        if (curr.getActiveFleet() != null) continue; // handled above
2024                        if (curr.getSource() != null && curr.getSource().equals(EconomyFleetRouteManager.SOURCE_ID) &&
2025                                        curr.getCustom() instanceof EconomyRouteData) {
2026                                EconomyRouteData data = (EconomyRouteData) curr.getCustom();
2027                                boolean fromExists = data.from != null && 
2028                                                 Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket(data.from.getId()) != null;
2029                                boolean toExists = data.to != null && 
2030                                                 Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket(data.to.getId()) != null;
2031                                if (!fromExists || !toExists) { 
2032                                        RouteManager.getInstance().removeRoute(curr);
2033                                }
2034                        }
2035                }
2036        }

2039        public static void shooPirates() {
2040                MarketAPI volturn = Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket("volturn");
2041                StarSystemAPI askonia = volturn.getStarSystem();
2042
2043                WeightedRandomPicker<MarketAPI> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<>();
2044                for (MarketAPI curr : Misc.getFactionMarkets(Factions.PIRATES)) {
2045                        picker.add(curr, curr.getSize());
2046                }
2047                
2048                for (CampaignFleetAPI fleet : askonia.getFleets()) {
2049                        if (!fleet.getFaction().getId().equals(Factions.PIRATES)) continue;
2050                        
2051                        MemoryAPI mem = fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate();
2052                        String sourceId = mem.getString(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_SOURCE_MARKET);
2053                        MarketAPI source = Misc.getSourceMarket(fleet);
2054                        if (sourceId == null || source == null || !source.getFactionId().equals(Factions.PIRATES)) {
2055                                MarketAPI pick = picker.pick();
2056                                if (pick != null) {
2057                                        mem.set(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_SOURCE_MARKET, pick.getId());
2058                                        sourceId = mem.getString(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_SOURCE_MARKET);
2059                                        source = Misc.getSourceMarket(fleet);
2060                                }
2061                        }
2062                        if (sourceId != null && source != null) {
2063                                Misc.giveStandardReturnToSourceAssignments(fleet);
2064                                continue;
2065                        }
2066                        
2067                }       
2068        }

2070        public static void replacePersonOfPost(MarketAPI market, String postId) {
2071                PersonAPI found = null;
2072                for (CommDirectoryEntryAPI curr : market.getCommDirectory().getEntriesCopy()) {
2073                        if (curr.getEntryData() instanceof PersonAPI) {
2074                                PersonAPI person = (PersonAPI) curr.getEntryData();
2075                                if (postId.equals(person.getPostId())) {
2076                                        found = person;
2077                                        break;
2078                                }
2079                        }
2080                }
2081                
2082                if (found == null) return;
2083
2084                ImportantPeopleAPI ip = Global.getSector().getImportantPeople();
2085                ip.removePerson(found);
2086                market.getCommDirectory().removePerson(found);
2087
2088                
2089                PersonAPI replacement = market.getFaction().createRandomPerson();
2090                replacement.setImportance(found.getImportance());
2091                replacement.setPostId(found.getPostId());
2092                replacement.setRankId(found.getRankId());
2093                
2094                market.getCommDirectory().addPerson(replacement);
2095                market.addPerson(replacement);
2096                ip.addPerson(replacement);
2097                ip.getData(replacement).getLocation().setMarket(market);
2098                ip.checkOutPerson(replacement, "permanent_staff");
2099                if (market.getAdmin() == found) {
2100                        market.setAdmin(replacement);
2101                }
2102        }

2119                
2120                if (admin != null) {

2127                        market.addPerson(admin);

2129                        ip.addPerson(admin);
2130                        ip.getData(admin).getLocation().setMarket(market);

2132

2136                CampaignFleetAPI station = Misc.getStationFleet(market);
2137                if (station == null) station = Misc.getStationBaseFleet(market);
2138                if (station != null) {
2139                        station.setFaction(factionId, true);
2140                }
2141                
2142                for (SectorEntityToken curr : market.getConnectedEntities()) {
2143                        curr.setFaction(factionId);
2144                }
2145                
2146                replacePersonOfPost(market, Ranks.POST_STATION_COMMANDER);
2147                replacePersonOfPost(market, Ranks.POST_BASE_COMMANDER);
2148                replacePersonOfPost(market, Ranks.POST_OUTPOST_COMMANDER);
2149                replacePersonOfPost(market, Ranks.POST_PORTMASTER);

2152//              if (!market.hasSubmarket(Submarkets.SUBMARKET_OPEN)) {
2153//                      market.addSubmarket(Submarkets.SUBMARKET_OPEN);

2156//                      market.addSubmarket(Submarkets.SUBMARKET_BLACK);
2157//              }
2158//              if (Misc.isMilitary(market) || 
2159//                              market.hasIndustry(Industries.MILITARYBASE) ||

2161//                      if (!market.hasSubmarket(Submarkets.GENERIC_MILITARY)) {
2162//                              market.addSubmarket(Submarkets.GENERIC_MILITARY);
2163//                      }
2164//              }
2165                
2166                
2167                int unrest = Math.max(RecentUnrest.get(market).getPenalty(), minUnrest);
2168                RecentUnrest.get(market).setPenalty(unrest);
2169                
2170                if (market.getAdmin() == null || admin == null) {
2171                        ImportantPeopleAPI ip = Global.getSector().getImportantPeople();
2172                        if (market.getAdmin() != null) {
2173                                ip.removePerson(market.getAdmin());
2174                                market.getCommDirectory().removePerson(market.getAdmin());
2175                        }
2176                        
2177                        PersonAPI person = market.getFaction().createRandomPerson(StarSystemGenerator.random);
2178                        person.setRankId(Ranks.CITIZEN);
2179                        person.setPostId(Ranks.POST_ADMINISTRATOR);
2180                        
2181                        if (market.getSize() >= 8) {
2182                                person.setImportanceAndVoice(PersonImportance.VERY_HIGH, StarSystemGenerator.random);
2183                        } else if (market.getSize() >= 6) {
2184                                person.setImportanceAndVoice(PersonImportance.HIGH, StarSystemGenerator.random);

2186                                person.setImportanceAndVoice(PersonImportance.MEDIUM, StarSystemGenerator.random);
2187                        }
2188                        
2189                        person.addTag(Tags.CONTACT_TRADE);
2190                        
2191                        market.getCommDirectory().addPerson(person);
2192                        market.addPerson(person);
2193                        ip.addPerson(person);

2195                        ip.checkOutPerson(person, "permanent_staff");
2196                        admin = person;

2199                
2200                if (market.getId().equals("umbra") && !Factions.PIRATES.equals(factionId)) {
2201                        shooPirates();
2202                }
2203        }

2244                return fleet;

2846        public static class CivOnlyChecker implements Script {
2847                public CampaignFleetAPI fleet;
2848                public CivOnlyChecker(CampaignFleetAPI fleet) {
2849                        this.fleet = fleet;
2850                }
2851                @Override
2852                public void run() {
2853                        if (Misc.isFleetCivOnly(fleet)) {
2854                                fleet.clearAssignments();
2855                        }
2856                }
2857        }

2859        public static FleetMemberAPI addToFleet(CampaignFleetAPI fleet, String variantId, Random random) {
2860                FleetMemberAPI member = fleet.getFleetData().addFleetMember(variantId);
2861                member.setId(member.getVariant().getHullVariantId() + "_" + random.nextLong());
2862                ShipVariantAPI v = member.getVariant().clone();
2863                v.setSource(VariantSource.REFIT);
2864                v.addTag(Tags.TAG_NO_AUTOFIT);
2865                if (Misc.isAutomated(member)) {
2866                        v.addTag(Tags.TAG_AUTOMATED_PENALTY);
2867                }
2868                member.setVariant(v, false, true);
2869                return member;
2870        }
2871        
2872        public static PersonAPI createOfficer(
2873                        CampaignFleetAPI fleet, int level, int numElite, SkillPickPreference pref, String personalityId, Random random) {
2874                FactionAPI faction = fleet.getFaction();
2875                PersonAPI officer = OfficerManagerEvent.createOfficer(
2876                                faction, level, pref, 
2877                                false, fleet, true, true, numElite, random);
2878                officer.setPersonality(personalityId);
2879                return officer;
2880        }
2881}
